author_budget.exceptions: Parent must explicitly approve any relaxed freeze; no silent grandfathering of tuple contracts or prior word lemmas.

completion_matrix.requirement: Pinned native struct and all nine bodies (bits_in_range, required_words, data_index_of, select_mask, len, resize, get, set, clear); keep inclusive for, Vec growth, mutable slot borrow, arithmetic and assertions; audit erased annotations.
valid iff len<=64*stored_len; unrestricted u32 old/new, arbitrary words/padding/spares; qualified 32/64 and debug/release, existing allocation/abort treatment.
Native universal theorem: valid result, logical len=n, stored len=max(old_storage,ceil(n/64)).
For every live bit below min(old_len,n), preserve value; direct native get composition.
Every old_len<=q<n equals full, including partial words and preexisting spare storage.
All original stored bits outside [old_len,n) unchanged; every appended word exactly default including padding.
Native shrink-to-zero and arbitrary shrink/regrow compositions reinitialize hidden bits, with exact storage frame.
Native get/set/clear compose after resize; selected-bit and full stored frame; set returns entire selected u64==MAX.
Same executable body, full domain, no replacement helper; remove measured routine proof work with generic production assistance.
One authored semantic predicate/three flattened clauses, one entry snapshot, one cursor label; zero authored routine proof plumbing.
Nonbitmap unsigned scalar/pair, Vec-growth/range/frame and bit-observation regressions; intended false-property controls.
Real local/provider/imported native proofs and dependency hashes; distinguish ordinary contracts, sound summaries and exact synthesis.
Cold/warm mandatory checks; seeded semantic/safety/resource/import failures; distinguish failed interface removal from stale rlib.
Wrong native updates/range/prefix/padding/length/regrowth/flag and weak/missing domains rejected with intended diagnostics.
Matching production source/runtime/vstd/toolchain identity; immutable inventory and integrated build attestation.
Focused production Rust/VIR/Python normal and -O checks plus previous accepted targets/common frontdoors.
Real composed acceptance receipts and guards tested with malformed inputs and isolated guard removals.
Fresh independent review of mechanics, native theorem, integration, source fidelity and author budget; findings resolved.
Exact accepted tree reconstruction and baseline-relative deltas, immutable pins, unchanged own Git state, qualified shared refs.
Per-row final audit, reproducible artifacts/commands, honest automation and outstanding-boundary accounting.

domain.allocation: existing vstd returning-call/resource/abort treatment; no OOM recovery or availability theorem
domain.architectures: Verus Either32Or64 or explicitly accepted proof configuration; native execution qualified separately
domain.stored_words: arbitrary valid Vec<u64>, including spare words and arbitrary padding

conditions: no application axioms or assumed mutable-state summaries
new_trusted_correspondence_authorized.kind: trusted Rust standard-library correspondence, not verified std implementation

operation_intent.appended_words: forall j in [old.data.len,after.data.len): after.data[j] == (u64::MAX if full else 0)
operation_intent.original_stored_bits: forall q in [0,64*old.data.len): after_bit(q) == (full if old.len<=q<new_len else old_bit(q))
operation_intent.set_return: entire final selected stored word == u64::MAX

precision_policy.bounded_target: ordinary authored high-level contracts proved by reusable assistance
precision_policy.exact_state_synthesis_expansion: requires explicit additional parent scope; ordinary theorem completeness is not synthesis exactness
precision_policy.sound_mutation_summaries: permitted only with soundness label and actual certified contracts

prohibited_narrowing: minimal storage equality or zero padding
checked arithmetic helper replacement counted as native
assumed bitmap summaries/axioms or external_body wrappers
standalone existing math or finite oracle counted as new inference

clauses: forall q in [0,64*M): self_bit(q) == (full if E.len<=q<new_len && q<64*k else E_bit(q) if q<64*E.data@.len() else full)
